name: routing-heldout-v1
description: Held-out routing set: the messages of YBM's end-to-end test catalogue (e2e/all_cases.json), written for other tests before the decision-model work. Labels follow fixed rules: the routes of the tools each case requires (any of them counts as right; the first is `route`), hand labels for the four cases that require no tool. Placeholders are filled with made-up paths. No real user data.

route_question.instructions: A user sent this message to a bot that does things on their own Windows computer. Which route should handle it? Pick conversation for greetings, thanks, questions about the bot itself, and general-knowledge questions that need nothing from this computer. Pick status only for questions about the bot's own running tasks or queue. Anything that has to look at, change, open, send, schedule or build something on this computer or the web belongs to one of the other routes.

criteria.conversation: pure chat, greeting, thanks, a question about the bot's abilities, or a general-knowledge question that needs nothing from this computer
criteria.status: a question about the bot's own running tasks, queue or progress
criteria.desktop.observe: look at the screen or desktop as a picture: screenshot, what is open, what window is in front
criteria.computer.use: do something in a desktop app: open an app, click, type, press keys, close a window
criteria.browser.open: open a website or Chrome, search the web, summarize pages, research across pages, screenshot a page
criteria.browser.control: act inside a web page: log in, click buttons, fill and submit forms, scroll, extract page data
criteria.filesystem.manage: inspect, search, read, write, create, rename, move, delete or organize files and folders
criteria.document.manage: read or summarize a PDF, or create or revise a presentation or document
criteria.artifact.deliver: send an existing file or screenshot back to the user's chat
criteria.code.interpreter: write and run a small script for a calculation, a data transform or a chart
criteria.coding.agent: hand a coding job to Codex or GitHub Copilot, only when the user names one of them
criteria.schedule.manage: create, list, pause, resume, delete or run recurring or timed jobs and reminders
criteria.adapter.factory: build a new tool or integration the bot does not have yet
criteria.workspace.manage: prepare a project workspace, materialize files, launch a local preview
criteria.configuration: change model profiles, access modes or runtime settings
